**Mexican Municipalities to State Capitals**

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Distance and adjacency from Mexican municipalities to state capitals.
#
# Produces, for each municipality:
#   - distance to ITS OWN state's capital (point-based and polygon-based)
#   - distance to the NEAREST capital of any state, + which one
#   - whether the municipality IS a state capital
#   - whether it is ADJACENT to (shares a border with) its state's capital
#   - counts of capitals within radius bands
#
# Distances in KILOMETERS, computed in EPSG:6372 (Mexico ITRF2008 / LCC).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. CONFIG
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

MUN_PATH  <- "/Users/marileekarinshak/MexicoProject/harris-week7/data/raw/Shapefiles/Mun Shapefile/Mexico_mun_layer_simplified.shp"

CAP_PATH  <- "/Users/marileekarinshak/MexicoProject/harris-week7/data/raw/StateCap/mexico_state_capitals.csv"

MUN_ID    <- "CVEGEO"   # 5-digit municipality code (2-digit state + 3-digit muni)
CRS_PROJ  <- 6372       # Mexico ITRF2008 / LCC -- meters
BANDS_KM  <- c(100, 200)

# Distance under which a municipality is treated as "near" its capital.
# Stands in for the boundary-adjacency measure we're skipping.
NEAR_KM   <- 50

OUT_CSV   <- "/Users/marileekarinshak/MexicoProject/harris-week7/data/processed/StateCap/municipality_capital_distances.csv"
OUT_RDS   <- "/Users/marileekarinshak/MexicoProject/harris-week7/data/processed/StateCap/municipality_capital_distances.rds"
```

```{r}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. STATE CODE CROSSWALK
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# The capitals CSV uses ISO 3166-2:MX alpha codes; CVEGEO uses INEGI
# numeric codes 01-32. INEGI orders states alphabetically under the
# traditional Spanish alphabet, where "ch" sorts after "c" -- hence
# Coahuila (05) and Colima (06) precede Chiapas (07) and Chihuahua (08).

ISO_TO_INEGI <- c(
  AGU = "01", BCN = "02", BCS = "03", CAM = "04", COA = "05", COL = "06",
  CHP = "07", CHH = "08", CMX = "09", DUR = "10", GUA = "11", GRO = "12",
  HID = "13", JAL = "14", MEX = "15", MIC = "16", MOR = "17", NAY = "18",
  NLE = "19", OAX = "20", PUE = "21", QUE = "22", ROO = "23", SLP = "24",
  SIN = "25", SON = "26", TAB = "27", TAM = "28", TLA = "29", VER = "30",
  YUC = "31", ZAC = "32"
)

```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. LOAD
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

mun <- st_read(MUN_PATH, quiet = TRUE)

# explicit col_types avoids the vroom parsing warning
caps <- read_csv(CAP_PATH, show_col_types = FALSE,
                 col_types = cols(
                   state      = col_character(),
                   state_code = col_character(),
                   capital    = col_character(),
                   latitude   = col_double(),
                   longitude  = col_double()
                 ))

cat("Municipalities:", nrow(mun), "\n")
cat("Capitals:      ", nrow(caps), "(expect 32)\n\n")

stopifnot(MUN_ID %in% names(mun))
stopifnot(nrow(caps) == 32)
stopifnot(!any(is.na(caps$latitude)), !any(is.na(caps$longitude)))

caps$state_num <- ISO_TO_INEGI[caps$state_code]
if (any(is.na(caps$state_num))) {
  stop("Unmapped state_code values: ",
       paste(caps$state_code[is.na(caps$state_num)], collapse = ", "))
}
stopifnot(!any(duplicated(caps$state_num)))

# check coordinates fall within Mexico's bounding box
stopifnot(all(caps$latitude  > 14 & caps$latitude  < 33))
stopifnot(all(caps$longitude > -118 & caps$longitude < -86))
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. CLEAN + REPROJECT
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

mun <- st_make_valid(mun)
stopifnot(all(st_is_valid(mun)))
mun <- st_transform(mun, CRS_PROJ)

mun$state_num <- str_sub(str_pad(as.character(mun[[MUN_ID]]),
                                 width = 5, pad = "0"), 1, 2)

cat("States in municipality layer:", length(unique(mun$state_num)),
    "(expect 32)\n\n")

cap_pts <- st_as_sf(caps, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) |>
  st_transform(CRS_PROJ)
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. CENTROIDS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

cent <- st_centroid(mun)

# Substitute point-on-surface where the centroid falls outside its polygon
inside_own <- diag(st_intersects(cent, mun, sparse = FALSE))
bad <- which(!inside_own)
cat("Centroids outside own polygon:", length(bad), "-> point-on-surface\n")
if (length(bad) > 0) {
  pos <- st_point_on_surface(mun[bad, ])
  st_geometry(cent)[bad] <- st_geometry(pos)
}
stopifnot(nrow(cent) == nrow(mun), sum(st_is_empty(cent)) == 0)
cat("\n")

```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. IDENTIFY EACH STATE'S CAPITAL MUNICIPALITY
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Point-in-polygon. Robust to simplification: capital city points sit
# well inside their municipality, not near the boundary.

contain <- st_within(cap_pts, mun)
n_hits  <- lengths(contain)

if (any(n_hits == 0)) {
  cat("Capital points outside all polygons -> using nearest municipality:\n")
  print(as.data.frame(caps[n_hits == 0, c("state", "capital")]))
  cat("\n")
}

cap_row <- integer(nrow(cap_pts))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(cap_pts))) {
  cap_row[i] <- if (n_hits[i] >= 1) contain[[i]][1] else
    st_nearest_feature(cap_pts[i, ], mun)
}

cap_pts$cap_cvegeo    <- as.character(mun[[MUN_ID]])[cap_row]
cap_pts$cap_state_geo <- mun$state_num[cap_row]

# VALIDATION: containing municipality should be in the capital's own state
mismatch <- cap_pts$cap_state_geo != cap_pts$state_num
cat("--- capital point validation ---\n")
if (any(mismatch)) {
  cat("MISMATCH -- capital point lands in the wrong state:\n")
  print(st_drop_geometry(cap_pts)[mismatch,
                                  c("state", "capital", "state_num", "cap_state_geo", "cap_cvegeo")])
  cat("-> verify lat/long for these rows\n")
} else {
  cat("All 32 capital points land inside their own state. OK\n")
}
cat("\n")

```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. MATCH EACH MUNICIPALITY TO ITS OWN CAPITAL
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

own <- match(mun$state_num, cap_pts$state_num)
if (any(is.na(own))) {
  stop("Municipalities whose state has no capital in the CSV: ",
       paste(unique(mun$state_num[is.na(own)]), collapse = ", "))
}

# by_element = TRUE pairs row i of x with row i of y
d_own_city   <- as.numeric(st_distance(cent, cap_pts[own, ],
                                       by_element = TRUE)) / 1000
d_own_capmun <- as.numeric(st_distance(cent, cent[cap_row[own], ],
                                       by_element = TRUE)) / 1000


# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. NEAREST CAPITAL OF ANY STATE
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

D <- matrix(as.numeric(st_distance(cent, cap_pts)), nrow = nrow(mun))
idx <- apply(D, 1, which.min)
d_near <- D[cbind(seq_len(nrow(D)), idx)] / 1000

```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. ASSEMBLE
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

final <- tibble(
  !!MUN_ID       := as.character(mun[[MUN_ID]]),
  state_num       = mun$state_num,
  state_name      = cap_pts$state[own],
  own_capital     = cap_pts$capital[own],
  capital_cvegeo  = cap_pts$cap_cvegeo[own],
  
  # own state's capital
  dist_cap_own     = d_own_city,     # to the capital city point
  dist_capmun_own  = d_own_capmun,   # to the capital municipality's centroid
  
  # nearest capital of any state
  dist_cap_nearest = d_near,
  nearest_cap      = cap_pts$capital[idx],
  nearest_cap_state = cap_pts$state[idx],
  same_state_cap   = cap_pts$state_num[idx] == mun$state_num,
  
  # status
  is_capital       = as.character(mun[[MUN_ID]]) %in% cap_pts$cap_cvegeo
)

# derived
final$near_own_cap        <- final$dist_cap_own <= NEAR_KM
final$excess_dist_own_cap <- final$dist_cap_own - final$dist_cap_nearest
final$log_dist_cap_own    <- log1p(final$dist_cap_own)

# capitals within bands
for (b in BANDS_KM) {
  final[[paste0("n_caps_", b, "km")]] <- rowSums(D <= b * 1000)
}

```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. CHECKS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

cat("--- checks ---\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(final), "(expected", nrow(mun), ")\n")
cat("Duplicate IDs:", sum(duplicated(final[[MUN_ID]])), "\n")
cat("NA distances:", sum(is.na(final$dist_cap_own)), "\n")
cat("Flagged as capitals:", sum(final$is_capital), "(expect 32)\n")
cat("Own capital nearer than nearest capital (should be 0):",
    sum(final$excess_dist_own_cap < -1e-6), "\n")
cat("Capital municipalities with dist_cap_own > 0:",
    sum(final$dist_cap_own[final$is_capital &
                             final[[MUN_ID]] == final$capital_cvegeo] > 1e-6),
    "-- nonzero is expected here: the centroid is not the city point\n")
cat("Closer to ANOTHER state's capital:", sum(!final$same_state_cap), "\n")
cat("Within", NEAR_KM, "km of own capital:", sum(final$near_own_cap), "\n\n")

cat("Distance to own capital, km:\n")
print(summary(final$dist_cap_own))

cat("\nBy state -- distance to own capital (km):\n")
print(final |>
        group_by(state_name) |>
        summarise(n = n(),
                  mean_km   = round(mean(dist_cap_own), 1),
                  median_km = round(median(dist_cap_own), 1),
                  max_km    = round(max(dist_cap_own), 1),
                  .groups = "drop") |>
        arrange(desc(mean_km)) |>
        as.data.frame())
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. EXPORT
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

write_csv(final, OUT_CSV)
saveRDS(final, OUT_RDS)
cat("\nWrote", OUT_CSV, "--", nrow(final), "rows x", ncol(final), "cols\n")
```
